queries.name: identity
queries.sql: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_user AS role,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation,(SELECT ssl FROM pg_stat_ssl WHERE pid=pg_backend_pid()) AS ssl

queries.name: relations
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,c.relkind,CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('r','p') THEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) ELSE 0 END AS bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','S') ORDER BY 1

queries.name: columns
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,a.attname AS name,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,NOT a.attnotnull AS nullable FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY 1,a.attnum

queries.name: constraints
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,con.conname AS name,con.contype AS kind,con.convalidated AS validated,ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY u(k,o) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=con.conrelid AND a.attnum=u.k ORDER BY u.o) AS columns,CASE WHEN con.confrelid<>0 THEN (SELECT ns.nspname||'.'||cl.relname FROM pg_class cl JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=cl.relnamespace WHERE cl.oid=con.confrelid) END AS parent,ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(con.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY u(k,o) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=con.confrelid AND a.attnum=u.k ORDER BY u.o) AS parent_columns FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND con.contype IN ('p','f','u','c') ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: indexes
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS relation,i.relname AS name,x.indisvalid AND x.indisready AS valid FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: functions_triggers
queries.sql: SELECT 'function' AS kind,n.nspname||'.'||p.proname AS name,p.prosecdef AS safe,p.proconfig AS settings FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) UNION ALL SELECT 'trigger',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||t.tgname,t.tgenabled='O',NULL::text[] FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: journal
queries.sql: SELECT version,content_sha256,code_commit FROM ingest.schema_migrations ORDER BY version

queries.name: bootstrap_snapshot
queries.sql: SELECT snapshot_key,generation,status,manifest_sha256 FROM ingest.dataset_snapshots ORDER BY generation

queries.name: runtime_effective_privileges
queries.sql: SELECT 'table' AS kind,n.nspname||'.'||c.relname AS name,has_table_privilege(%s,c.oid,'SELECT') AS readable,has_table_privilege(%s,c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER') AS writable FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v') UNION ALL SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname,has_function_privilege(%s,p.oid,'EXECUTE'),false FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) UNION ALL SELECT 'sequence',n.nspname||'.'||c.relname,false,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN has_sequence_privilege(%s,c.oid,'USAGE,SELECT,UPDATE') ELSE false END FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=ANY(%s) AND c.relkind='S' ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: runtime_schema_access
queries.sql: SELECT nspname AS schema,has_schema_privilege(%s,oid,'USAGE') AS usable,has_schema_privilege(%s,oid,'CREATE') AS creatable FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=ANY(%s) ORDER BY 1

queries.name: retained_source_schema_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p')) AS tables,coalesce(sum(s.n_live_tup),0) AS estimated_rows FROM pg_namespace n LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.relnamespace=n.oid LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid=c.oid WHERE n.nspname IN ('statarena','statarena_app') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

limitations: Schema/bootstrap only; no real-source or public cutover acceptance
Source metadata estimates do not establish complete data fidelity or unchanged source bytes
newRelationStorageMeaning: Additive schema/bootstrap overhead, including indexes; not a storage saving
